hook: Your climb ends at a fortress on a rock.
title: Your Climb Ends at a Fortress on a Rock
description:
Sigiriya in Sri Lanka is a rock about 200 m high with the ruins of a fortress palace on top. It dates to the fifth century and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #SriLanka #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you climb it? Yes or no
